system.description:
A fighting art adapted from the Deteron dragon-kin: tough, direct, draconic.

  • Draconic Toughness: while below half HP, your unarmed damage die is one step larger (d4 to d6, d6 to d8, d8 to d10, d10 to d12).
    • 9th level: while below half HP, you also have Resistance 5 to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison.
  • Scale-Fist Bearing: Advantage on Intimidation checks, and on saves against fire.
